{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the response rate by arm, stratified by severity
response_by_arm_severity = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(response_by_arm_severity)"}
